title: Ferroptosis and immunity: rewiring the tumor microenvironment for therapy

Ferroptosis, a distinct form of programmed cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation, has emerged as a critical player in cancer biology, influencing both tumor progression and therapeutic responses.
